notes: IMDwindowshopper (WWW). WindowShopperToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 (OpenZeppelin ERC20 + ERC20Burnable + ERC20Permit) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 WWW (1e27 minor units) once to msg.sender, the launch factory; nothing can mint afterwards. There is no owner, no roles, no pause, no blocklist, no transfer fee and no upgrade path; holders may burn only their own tokens or tokens they hold an allowance for. No application contracts are deployed. Community: X x.com/windowshoppermd
